== Virtual Set 1 history (#1227) ==
=== Build notes ===
* The August 2022 issued printable slip and exact publisher composite both add “piloted” before the Independent icon. The rules announcement is dated 9 August and effective 15 August.
* The modern comparison covers two gameplay states. The shared Versions navigator retains the Decipher, Virtual Original, and Virtual Legacy articles in publication order.
=== Missing data ===
* The original March 2015 Set 1 launch sheet and its native image are missing from the recovered sources. The contemporary preview and tournament use support the year. The revised printable mirror and July 2018 face verify the earlier printed rules wording.

== March 2015 printable slip (#1227) ==
The recovered [https://web.archive.org/web/20150513073607id_/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/virtual/Set-1.pdf#page=1 Players Committee Virtual Set 1 printable sheet], p. 1 confirms Wooof's earlier Independent-starship wording. Its metadata dates the file to 25 March 2015, and the Players Committee catalog lists the set release as 27 March. The revision captured on 13 May provides a contemporary visual witness.
